method: Playwright headless UX journey — screenshots, scroll sections, console capture, interaction probes

issues: Float section nav (HERO/DIFFERENT/TRUST/…) consumes ~120px right rail; four-column Why cards and compare copy feel cramped against the sidebar
Compare section layout imbalance: four gold-bullet differentiators sit below only the left card, not aligned in a second row under both columns
Sky guides section has stray duplicate trust copy above filter chips ('links to computed tools…' + 'VSOP87 ephemeris · computed on your device') — reads like a leaked hero fragment
Jargon (VSOP87/ephemeris) appears in body cards without an immediate plain-language gloss for first-time visitors
Hero solar badge renders as 'O EXPERT SOLAR MODEL' — leading glyph looks like a broken/zero character rather than a deliberate icon
Guide overlay opens on card click but body scroll is not locked (overlayOpen=true, scroll lock false) — background may scroll behind modal
positives: Hero sky instrument visible (440×470px) — Expert Solar Model WebGL with live VSOP87 orbits; drag instruction clear
Hero H1 and standfirst readable on first paint (opacity 1); no scroll-reveal hiding on fresh load
Live dateline populated: Sun in Cancer · Moon in Capricorn
Compare section copy is sharp and differentiated (generic apps vs Astro Precise)
Why section four pillars (chart, readings, daily, synastry) scan well with numbered badges
Sky chapter shows live planet positions with sign/degree labels and Plate I instrument
10 sky guide cards load after scroll; filter chips (All guides, Chart, Rising, etc.) functional
Float nav scroll-spy works (active 'Different' on compare scroll); padding-inline-end 120px when nav visible
Zero console errors on homepage

meta.h1: You're not one of twelve.This chart is yours alone.

issues: 'Computing today's sky…' and planet legend placeholders (☉ Sun · …) visible for several seconds on first paint — feels broken before ephemeris resolves
Planet positions strip and scrolling sky board are collapsed/hidden by default (aria-expanded=false); live data easy to miss
Sky board toggle shows both labels in accessibility tree ('▾ Scrolling sky board' + '▴ Hide sky board') even when collapsed — confusing screen-reader label
'Go to my sign' silently redirects to chart.html when no saved natal chart — no inline explanation before navigation
'Centre star → your natal chart' hint is subtle; new users may not understand dial centre vs sign selection
Primary daily value (today's reading) is below the large dial + controls — requires extra scroll after picking a sign
positives: Horoscope title 'Today's Live Ecliptic' clear above fold with date stamp
Interactive zodiac dial renders with 12 sign glyphs and drag/tap affordance
'Go to my sign' and 'Explore a sign' CTAs present and enabled
Sky data resolves within ~6s with no console errors
REAL TRANSITS badge reinforces differentiation from generic horoscopes
Zero console errors after full load

issues: Required birth city field is ~1250px below top — not visible above fold; users only see name (+ partial date) on landing
Calculate My Chart submit button is ~1930px down — more than two viewport scrolls from hero
Form validation uses toast-only feedback (no .is-error on fields); empty submit easy to miss if toast is off-screen
Hero subtitle is dense VSOP87/arcminute jargon before user has entered any data
Large empty vertical space between marketing hero and form card — feels like a dead zone
Natal wheel mount in DOM with aria-busy=true in results area can imply a chart is loading before any input
positives: Birth chart form present with clear section labels (Identity, Moment of Birth, Place of Birth)
Privacy messaging prominent: 'birth data never leaves your device'
Place field exists with autocomplete + 'use my current location' once scrolled into view
Sample chart button available for try-before-you-enter
Zero console errors on chart page

topFixes.issue: Chart page buries required birth city (~1250px) and submit (~1930px) below fold — users land on name-only and cannot complete a chart without extensive scrolling
topFixes.fix: Collapse hero on chart.html to a single-line title; move Identity + Moment + Place + submit into one compact above-fold card; sticky 'Calculate' bar on mobile.

topFixes.issue: Horoscope shows 'Computing today's sky…' and 'Sun · …' placeholders for several seconds — first impression feels broken
topFixes.fix: SSR or inline-cache yesterday's positions as skeleton; swap to live VSOP87 values with a subtle 'Updated just now' tick; hide legend until coords resolve.

topFixes.issue: 'Go to my sign' redirects to chart.html without warning when no saved chart — abrupt context switch
topFixes.fix: If !getUserSign(), open inline prompt: 'We need your birth chart first' with CTA to chart.html; only redirect on confirm.

topFixes.issue: Chart validation is toast-only — empty submit does not highlight fields
topFixes.fix: On readForm() error, add .is-error to form-group, show .form-error-msg, scrollIntoView the first invalid field.

topFixes.issue: Horoscope planet positions and sky board hidden by default — live sky data easy to miss
topFixes.fix: Auto-expand planet legend once ephemeris loads; default sky board open on desktop; simplify toggle to single dynamic label.

topFixes.issue: Sky guides section has stray duplicate VSOP87 trust lines above filter chips
topFixes.fix: Remove or relocate #skyGuidesTrust duplicate; keep one trust line inside .ap-chapter-lead only.

topFixes.issue: Homepage float nav compresses compare/why four-column grids against right rail
topFixes.fix: Reduce nav to icons-only under 1280px; or stack cards 2×2 when ap-award-511--nav-visible.

topFixes.issue: Guide overlay does not lock body scroll — background scrolls behind modal
topFixes.fix: On #sgOverlay open add body.sg-overlay-open { overflow: hidden } and focus trap; remove on close.
